description: Exposure rules — paths that, when returning a matching status + body signature, constitute a finding rather than just a new endpoint. Matched after ffuf's path phase.

rules.name: Exposed .git directory
rules.description: The web server exposes the .git directory. An attacker can reconstruct source code and extract embedded secrets.

rules.name: Exposed .env file
rules.description: The web server exposes a .env file, typically containing database credentials, API keys, and secrets.

rules.name: WordPress config backup exposed
rules.description: A backup of wp-config.php is served as plaintext, exposing database credentials and WordPress secret keys.

rules.name: Exposed AWS credentials file
rules.description: The AWS credentials file is publicly accessible. Rotate the exposed keys immediately.

rules.name: Exposed SSH private key
rules.description: An SSH private key is publicly served by the web server.

rules.name: Spring Boot /actuator/env exposed
rules.description: Spring Boot actuator endpoints are exposed without authentication. /env leaks configuration, /heapdump leaks memory contents.

rules.name: phpinfo() page exposed
rules.description: A phpinfo() page is publicly accessible, leaking PHP version, loaded modules, and environment variables.

rules.name: Apache mod_status exposed
rules.description: Apache server-status / server-info page is publicly accessible, leaking internal request URIs and server configuration.

rules.name: Debug endpoint exposed
rules.description: A Go pprof debug endpoint is publicly accessible, allowing memory/CPU profiling and potentially DoS.

rules.name: Prometheus /metrics endpoint exposed
rules.description: Prometheus metrics endpoint is publicly accessible. Low-severity info disclosure but can leak internal hostnames, request paths, and build versions.

rules.name: Dockerfile exposed
rules.description: Dockerfile or compose file is publicly accessible. May leak base image versions, build arguments, and service configuration.

rules.name: package.json exposed
rules.description: Dependency manifest is publicly accessible. Low-risk but exposes the application's dependency graph for supply-chain reconnaissance.

rules.name: .DS_Store exposed
rules.description: macOS .DS_Store file is publicly accessible. Reveals directory contents.
